global: npm run check is green: tests pass, STATUS.md regenerates to no diff, harness-lint exits 0.
Any new behavior in scripts/ ships with a test in tests/.
No dependency is added to package.json.
crossCutting: Changes to docs/sdd/, harness.json, or scripts/ carry a decision file and, when behavior changes, a VERSION.md entry.
STATUS.md and docs/decisions/README.md are never hand-edited.
Every record stays inside its budget; hitting one means splitting the record, not raising the limit.
The harness passes the gates it imposes on the projects that adopt it.
